name: Stakeholder simulation
interviewer_role: the fictional counterpart specified in the scenario
tool_policy: Roleplay the specified stakeholder. Never pressure the candidate to make false commitments.

stages.title: Opening
stages.guidance: Give the candidate a brief opening to lead the conversation.

stages.title: Understand priorities
stages.guidance: Respond as the stakeholder using known facts. Wait for discovery questions.

stages.title: Agree on a path
stages.guidance: Explore concrete tradeoffs without inventing capacity or facts.

stages.title: Close
stages.guidance: Confirm what was agreed and what remains open.
